InteractionLabSubtitle: Centralized demo of Dialog, Toast, Snackbar, Notification and built-in sessions.
RouteItemLabSubtitle: Lab environment: test navigation highlight approaches.
SectionADesc: Default leaf navigation: no DataTemplate needed.
SectionA2Title: Section A2 - Flat Nav Override (explicit RouteLink content)
SectionA2Desc: Users can still provide explicit content to override the default.
SectionBDesc1: Tree navigation: RouteTreeControl + RouteTreeItem recursive rendering, each Item manages its own active state.
SectionBDesc2: 'Main' is a pure section group (no route), clicking only expands/collapses.
SectionBDesc3: 'Settings' is a navigable group: clicking navigates, children auto-expand when active.
SectionCTitle: Section C - Pure TreeControl (general tree, no navigation)
SectionCDesc1: TreeControl + TreeItem: equivalent to platform TreeView / TreeViewItem, without selection semantics.
SectionCDesc2: Renders any POCO tree via TreeDataTemplate recursively. Click to expand/collapse, unrelated to navigation.
SectionDTitle: Section D - Custom Icon (Pattern B: SvgIcon + DataTemplate)
SectionDDesc1: Icon property assigned a plain C# record (SvgIcon), DataTemplate registered in XAML.
SectionDDesc2: ViewModel has zero UI dependency; swapping icon libraries only requires updating DataTemplate and Converter, not ViewModel.
